name: 89706 · Carson City, NV
findings: ZIP 89706 (Carson City) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 14 organizations.
Political organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89706 (Carson City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89706 (Carson City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
